annotations.title: Sign and accept pinned work-order terms

description: Accept a work order as buyer or provider by signing the exact role-specific challenge returned by work_order_open. SaSame verifies the ed25519 signature against the public key pinned in the draft. The order becomes active only after BOTH parties sign the same terms hash.

signature_base64.description: ed25519 signature over the exact acceptance challenge

name: work_order_accept
